name: Microvoxel Realms
author: Stratum
description: Generates the world in quarter-block microvoxels: an ancient West African land of red laterite and grove turf, iroko, oil palm and baobab, and the built-in pack's towns - the home town first - as walled compounds of mud and thatch with uli-painted walls and round huts. Plays on the built-in pack's blocks, creatures and towns.
